name: Mercado Libre
description: LATAM's largest marketplace: read items, catalog products and their competing listings, orders, shipping costs, fees, visits, trends and buyer questions, manage the seller's own listings (create, validate, change price, stock and description, pause or close) and promotions, and read Product Ads campaigns and metrics on Brasil (MLB), Argentina (MLA), Mexico (MLM), Chile (MLC), Colombia (MCO), Peru (MPE) and Uruguay (MLU). Sign in with the seller's Mercado Libre account.
instructions:
This connector uses the Mercado Libre REST API (api.mercadolibre.com), one API for every country site. Every endpoint needs the seller's OAuth2 sign-in; unauthenticated calls get 401 or 403.

**Setup**: in the developer center of your country (https://developers.mercadolibre.com/devcenter) create an application, register the redirect URI `<your AnythingMCP URL>/api/mcp-oauth/callback` (on AnythingMCP Cloud: `https://cloud.anythingmcp.com/api/mcp-oauth/callback`) and copy the App ID and the Secret Key into `MERCADO_LIBRE_CLIENT_ID` and `MERCADO_LIBRE_CLIENT_SECRET`. `MERCADO_LIBRE_SITE_DOMAIN` picks the sign-in page of the seller's country (mercadolivre.com.br, mercadolibre.com.ar, mercadolibre.com.mx, mercadolibre.cl, mercadolibre.com.co, mercadolibre.com.pe, mercadolibre.com.uy). Leave the application's notifications callback URL empty and select no topics. If the developer center requires one, enter the redirect URI above: AnythingMCP answers Mercado Libre's notifications and ignores them. Then authorize the connector with the seller account. Keep the scopes `offline_access read write`: the listing tools need write.

**Site ids**: MLB = Brasil, MLA = Argentina, MLM = Mexico, MLC = Chile, MCO = Colombia, MPE = Peru, MLU = Uruguay. Item ids carry the site prefix (`MLB1234567890`), and so do category ids (`MLB1055`).

**Your seller id**: `mercado_libre_get_user` with user_id `me` returns the signed-in account; its `id` is the seller id for `mercado_libre_list_seller_items` and `mercado_libre_list_orders`. Seller endpoints only answer for the signed-in seller.

**No marketplace search**: Mercado Libre refuses its public listing search (`/sites/{site_id}/search`) to third-party applications with 403, so this connector has none. `mercado_libre_list_seller_items` lists the signed-in seller's own listings (by status or SKU), and `mercado_libre_get_item` reads any listing by id.

**Creating a listing** (there is no sandbox, so whatever is created is live):
1. `mercado_libre_predict_category` with the product title gives the category_id.
2. `mercado_libre_get_category_attributes` lists the attributes; send every one tagged required (often BRAND, MODEL, GTIN). `mercado_libre_get_category_sale_terms` gives the warranty fields and `mercado_libre_list_listing_types` the listing types (gold_special = classic, gold_pro = premium). `mercado_libre_get_category` has the limits: max_title_length, max_pictures_per_item, minimum_price.
3. `mercado_libre_validate_listing` with the full listing; an empty answer means it would be accepted. A 400 whose causes are all `type: warning` also means it would be accepted; only causes of `type: error` block it.
4. `mercado_libre_create_listing`, then `mercado_libre_add_listing_description` with the text.

**Title or family_name**: sellers on the User Products model (most sellers since 2025) send `family_name`, a generic product name such as 'Apple iPhone 15 128GB', and no `title`: Mercado Libre writes the title itself. Sellers still on the old model send `title`. The error 'The fields [title] are invalid' means: send family_name instead. A listing that has a family_name does not accept title changes.

**Changing listings**: `mercado_libre_update_listing` changes price, stock, pictures, attributes and sale terms (send only what changes; pictures and attributes replace the whole list). Stock 0 pauses the listing until stock comes back. `mercado_libre_set_listing_status` pauses or reactivates, `mercado_libre_update_listing_description` replaces the text. Title, condition and buying mode are locked once a listing has sales. `mercado_libre_close_listing` ends a listing for good and is installed switched off. Every write acts on the live shop: confirm each one with the user.

**Orders and costs**: `mercado_libre_get_order` reads one order, `mercado_libre_get_shipment_costs` the shipping cost of its shipment, `mercado_libre_get_listing_prices` the selling fee for a price and `mercado_libre_get_free_shipping_cost` what free shipping would cost the seller. `mercado_libre_get_items` reads up to 20 listings at once.

**Performance and competition**: `mercado_libre_get_item_visits` (totals between two dates) and `mercado_libre_get_item_visits_by_day` (daily series, up to 150 days). For catalog listings `mercado_libre_list_product_items` shows the other sellers on the same product page, `mercado_libre_get_product` the product and its current winner, and `mercado_libre_get_item_price_to_win` the price that would win. `mercado_libre_get_category_trends` lists the most searched keywords of a category.

**Questions**: `mercado_libre_search_questions` with the seller id and status UNANSWERED lists open questions; `mercado_libre_post_answer` publishes an answer and is installed switched off, because an answer is public and cannot be edited.

**Promotions** (seller-promotions API, `app_version=v2` is sent for you): `mercado_libre_list_seller_promotions` lists the invitations and campaigns, `mercado_libre_get_promotion` and `mercado_libre_list_promotion_items` read one, `mercado_libre_get_item_promotions` shows the promotions of one listing. `mercado_libre_add_item_to_promotion` joins a promotion; for DEAL, SELLER_CAMPAIGN, DOD and LIGHTNING you set deal_price, for co-funded ones (MARKETPLACE_CAMPAIGN, SMART, PRICE_MATCHING) the price comes with the invitation. Every call needs the promotion type as well as the id. `mercado_libre_remove_item_from_promotion` is installed switched off.

**Product Ads**: `mercado_libre_list_advertisers` gives the advertiser_id and site_id; then `mercado_libre_search_ad_campaigns`, `mercado_libre_get_ad_campaign`, `mercado_libre_search_product_ads` and `mercado_libre_search_ad_groups` read campaigns, ads and their metrics (pass date_from, date_to and metrics; at most 90 days back, refreshed daily). These tools only read; the seller needs Product Ads enabled in Mercado Ads, otherwise the advertiser list is empty.

**Rate limits**: Mercado Libre answers 429 when an application sends too many requests. Wait before retrying and do not fire many listing changes in parallel.
prerequisites: An application in the Mercado Libre developer center of **your country**, with the redirect URI shown below registered exactly. Leave its notifications callback URL empty, or enter the redirect URI there too if the developer center requires one.

MERCADO_LIBRE_CLIENT_ID.label: App ID
MERCADO_LIBRE_CLIENT_ID.help: Developer center → your application: the App ID (Client ID).
MERCADO_LIBRE_CLIENT_ID.patternMessage: The App ID is a number of about 16 digits, shown at the top of your application in the developer center.

MERCADO_LIBRE_CLIENT_SECRET.label: Secret key
MERCADO_LIBRE_CLIENT_SECRET.help: Same page: the Secret Key (Client Secret).
MERCADO_LIBRE_CLIENT_SECRET.patternMessage: The Secret Key is a string of about 32 letters and digits, on the same page as the App ID. It is not your Mercado Libre password.

MERCADO_LIBRE_SITE_DOMAIN.label: Country site
MERCADO_LIBRE_SITE_DOMAIN.help: The Mercado Libre site your account is on: mercadolivre.com.br (Brazil), mercadolibre.com.ar, mercadolibre.com.mx, mercadolibre.cl, mercadolibre.com.co, mercadolibre.com.uy, mercadolibre.com.pe.
MERCADO_LIBRE_SITE_DOMAIN.patternMessage: One of the country sites listed, e.g. mercadolibre.com.mx.

tools.name: mercado_libre_get_item
tools.description: Fetch full details for a Mercado Libre item by id. Returns title, description, price, currency, listing type, all attributes (brand, model, condition, …), pictures, available_quantity, sold_quantity, warranty, seller_id, and shipping options.

item_id.description: Mercado Libre item id including site prefix (e.g. 'MLB1234567890').

tools.name: mercado_libre_get_user
tools.description: Get a user's public profile (typically used to inspect a seller). Returns id, nickname, country_id, registration_date, seller_reputation (level_id, transactions completed/canceled, ratings positive/neutral/negative), and listing site.

tools.name: mercado_libre_list_orders
tools.description: List orders for an authenticated seller. Requires an OAuth2 token belonging to the seller. Returns order id, status (paid/cancelled/confirmed), date_created, total amount, buyer summary, order items, and shipping details.

seller.description: Seller id (must match the authenticated user's id).

tools.name: mercado_libre_predict_category
tools.description: Suggest the category for a new listing from its title (the category predictor). Returns up to 8 predictions, most likely first, each with category_id, category_name, domain_id and the attributes it read from the title (e.g. BRAND, MODEL). Start here before creating a listing.

site_id.description: Site code: MLB=Brasil, MLA=Argentina, MLM=Mexico, MLC=Chile, MCO=Colombia, MPE=Peru, MLU=Uruguay.

q.description: Product title in the site's language, e.g. 'celular iphone 15 128gb'.

tools.name: mercado_libre_get_category
tools.description: Read a category and the rules a listing in it must follow: path_from_root, listing_allowed, status, and settings such as max_title_length, buying_modes, currencies, item_conditions, max_pictures_per_item, minimum_price and shipping_modes.

tools.name: mercado_libre_get_category_attributes
tools.description: List the attributes (technical specifications) of a category: id, name, value_type, allowed values with their value_id, and tags. Attributes tagged required must be sent to create a listing, new_required ones when the condition is new; read_only ones cannot be set.

tools.name: mercado_libre_get_category_sale_terms
tools.description: List the sale terms of a category, such as WARRANTY_TYPE and WARRANTY_TIME with their allowed values and units, to fill sale_terms when creating or changing a listing.

tools.name: mercado_libre_list_listing_types
tools.description: List the listing types of a site (e.g. gold_pro, gold_special, free) with their names. A listing needs a listing_type_id; exposure and selling fees depend on it.

site_id.description: Site code: MLB=Brasil, MLA=Argentina, MLM=Mexico, MLC=Chile, MCO=Colombia, MPE=Peru, MLU=Uruguay.

tools.name: mercado_libre_list_seller_items
tools.description: List the ids of a seller's listings, 50 per page by default (max 100), optionally filtered by status or SKU. Use mercado_libre_get_user with user_id 'me' to find your own seller id, and mercado_libre_get_item for the details of each id. offset stops at 1000.

user_id.description: Seller id (numeric). Must be the account the connector is signed in with.

seller_sku.description: Only listings whose SELLER_SKU attribute has this value.

tools.name: mercado_libre_validate_listing
tools.description: Check a new listing without publishing it. Takes the same fields as mercado_libre_create_listing; an empty answer (HTTP 204) means it would be accepted. Otherwise Mercado Libre answers 400 with a cause list: each cause has a type. Causes of type 'error' (missing attributes, wrong fields, title not allowed) block the listing and must be fixed. Causes of type 'warning' only advise (e.g. shipping.lost_me1_by_user, item.shipping.mandatory_free_shipping): a 400 whose causes are all warnings means the listing would still be accepted, so report the warnings and go ahead. Run this before creating.

family_name.description: Generic product name shared by its variants, e.g. 'Apple iPhone 15 128GB'. Required for sellers on the User Products model (most sellers now); Mercado Libre then writes the title itself. At most the category's max_title_length.

title.description: Listing title, only for sellers still on the old model (Product + brand + model + key specs, no condition, stock or shipping words). If Mercado Libre answers 'The fields [title] are invalid', send family_name instead.

price.description: Price in the site currency, e.g. 199.9.

currency_id.description: Currency of the site: BRL, ARS, MXN, CLP, COP, PEN or UYU.

available_quantity.description: Units in stock (0 creates the listing paused, out of stock).

listing_type_id.description: Listing type, e.g. gold_special (classic) or gold_pro (premium); see mercado_libre_list_listing_types.

pictures.description: Pictures as [{"source": "https://...jpg"}]: public image URLs, the first one is the cover. The category sets the maximum (max_pictures_per_item).

attributes.description: Technical specifications as [{"id": "BRAND", "value_name": "Apple"}] or with "value_id" for list values. Send every attribute tagged required in mercado_libre_get_category_attributes (often BRAND, MODEL and GTIN); a SKU goes in SELLER_SKU.

sale_terms.description: Sale terms such as the warranty: [{"id": "WARRANTY_TYPE", "value_name": "Garantia do vendedor"}, {"id": "WARRANTY_TIME", "value_name": "90 dias"}]. Allowed values: mercado_libre_get_category_sale_terms.

value_name.description: Value as text, with its unit where it has one.

shipping.description: Optional shipping settings, e.g. {"mode": "me2", "free_shipping": false, "local_pick_up": false}. Leave out to use the seller's defaults.

tools.name: mercado_libre_create_listing
tools.description: Publish a new listing on the seller's account; it goes live and can sell at once. Send family_name (User Products sellers) or title, never both. Get category_id from mercado_libre_predict_category and the required attributes from mercado_libre_get_category_attributes, run mercado_libre_validate_listing first, then add the text with mercado_libre_add_listing_description. Show the user the listing and wait for confirmation; never retry a successful create.

family_name.description: Generic product name shared by its variants, e.g. 'Apple iPhone 15 128GB'. Required for sellers on the User Products model (most sellers now); Mercado Libre then writes the title itself. At most the category's max_title_length.

title.description: Listing title, only for sellers still on the old model (Product + brand + model + key specs, no condition, stock or shipping words). If Mercado Libre answers 'The fields [title] are invalid', send family_name instead.

price.description: Price in the site currency, e.g. 199.9.

currency_id.description: Currency of the site: BRL, ARS, MXN, CLP, COP, PEN or UYU.

available_quantity.description: Units in stock (0 creates the listing paused, out of stock).

listing_type_id.description: Listing type, e.g. gold_special (classic) or gold_pro (premium); see mercado_libre_list_listing_types.

pictures.description: Pictures as [{"source": "https://...jpg"}]: public image URLs, the first one is the cover. The category sets the maximum (max_pictures_per_item).

attributes.description: Technical specifications as [{"id": "BRAND", "value_name": "Apple"}] or with "value_id" for list values. Send every attribute tagged required in mercado_libre_get_category_attributes (often BRAND, MODEL and GTIN); a SKU goes in SELLER_SKU.

sale_terms.description: Sale terms such as the warranty: [{"id": "WARRANTY_TYPE", "value_name": "Garantia do vendedor"}, {"id": "WARRANTY_TIME", "value_name": "90 dias"}]. Allowed values: mercado_libre_get_category_sale_terms.

value_name.description: Value as text, with its unit where it has one.

shipping.description: Optional shipping settings, e.g. {"mode": "me2", "free_shipping": false, "local_pick_up": false}. Leave out to use the seller's defaults.

tools.name: mercado_libre_update_listing
tools.description: Change a listing: price, stock (available_quantity), pictures, attributes, sale terms, video or shipping. Send only the fields to change; pictures and attributes replace the whole list. title only while nothing has sold and only on old-model listings (with family_name set, change family_name instead). Stock 0 pauses the listing. Confirm with the user first.

item_id.description: Listing id with its site prefix, e.g. 'MLB1234567890'.

price.description: New price in the listing currency.

available_quantity.description: New stock. 0 pauses the listing as out of stock; a positive number reactivates it.

title.description: New title. Only allowed while sold_quantity is 0 and the listing has no family_name.

family_name.description: New generic product name (User Products listings), only while no item of the product has sold.

pictures.description: Pictures as [{"source": "https://...jpg"}]: public image URLs, the first one is the cover. The category sets the maximum (max_pictures_per_item).

attributes.description: Technical specifications as [{"id": "BRAND", "value_name": "Apple"}] or with "value_id" for list values. Send every attribute tagged required in mercado_libre_get_category_attributes (often BRAND, MODEL and GTIN); a SKU goes in SELLER_SKU.

sale_terms.description: Sale terms such as the warranty: [{"id": "WARRANTY_TYPE", "value_name": "Garantia do vendedor"}, {"id": "WARRANTY_TIME", "value_name": "90 dias"}]. Allowed values: mercado_libre_get_category_sale_terms.

value_name.description: Value as text, with its unit where it has one.

tools.name: mercado_libre_set_listing_status
tools.description: Pause a listing (hidden from buyers, can be reactivated) or reactivate a paused one. A listing paused for lack of stock comes back by itself when mercado_libre_update_listing sets stock above 0. To end a listing for good use mercado_libre_close_listing. Confirm with the user first.

item_id.description: Listing id with its site prefix, e.g. 'MLB1234567890'.

status.description: paused hides the listing, active reactivates it.

tools.name: mercado_libre_close_listing
tools.description: End a listing for good (status closed). A closed listing cannot be reactivated, only relisted as a new one, so pause it with mercado_libre_set_listing_status unless the user wants it gone. Installed switched off; confirm with the user first.

item_id.description: Listing id with its site prefix, e.g. 'MLB1234567890'.

tools.name: mercado_libre_get_listing_description
tools.description: Read the description text of a listing (plain_text), with its creation and update dates.

item_id.description: Listing id with its site prefix, e.g. 'MLB1234567890'.

tools.name: mercado_libre_add_listing_description
tools.description: Add the description to a listing that has none yet, typically right after mercado_libre_create_listing. Plain text only (line breaks as \n, no HTML or emoji). If the listing already has a description Mercado Libre refuses it; use mercado_libre_update_listing_description. Confirm the text with the user first.

item_id.description: Listing id with its site prefix, e.g. 'MLB1234567890'.

plain_text.description: Description in plain text, in the site's language.

tools.name: mercado_libre_update_listing_description
tools.description: Replace the description of a listing. Plain text only (line breaks as \n, no HTML or emoji); an error names the position of a character that is not allowed. Possible whether or not the listing has sales. Confirm the text with the user first.

item_id.description: Listing id with its site prefix, e.g. 'MLB1234567890'.

plain_text.description: New description in plain text, in the site's language.

tools.name: mercado_libre_get_items
tools.description: Read up to 20 listings in one call (items multiget). Returns one entry per id with a code (200, 404, ...) and a body holding the listing. Pass attributes to get only the fields you need, e.g. id,title,price,available_quantity,sold_quantity,status. Use instead of many mercado_libre_get_item calls.

ids.description: Comma-separated listing ids with site prefix, at most 20, e.g. 'MLB1234567890,MLB2345678901'.

attributes.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. 'id,title,price,available_quantity,sold_quantity,status'. Leave out for the whole listing.

tools.name: mercado_libre_get_order
tools.description: Get one order by id: status, date, buyer nickname, order_items (listing, variation, quantity, unit price), payments, total_amount, shipping id, tags and the pack it belongs to. Order ids come from mercado_libre_list_orders. Only orders of the signed-in seller.

tools.name: mercado_libre_get_shipment_costs
tools.description: Get the cost breakdown of a shipment: what the buyer paid (receiver) and what the seller pays (senders), with discounts and the gross amount. The shipment id is shipping.id of an order from mercado_libre_get_order.

tools.name: mercado_libre_get_free_shipping_cost
tools.description: Quote what the seller pays to offer free shipping (Mercado Envios) for a listing or for a package size: returns the coverage cost the seller pays and, with verbose, the breakdown and discounts. Pass item_id for an existing listing, or dimensions with item_price, listing_type_id, mode, condition and logistic_type for a product not yet listed; leaving them out gives inconsistent quotes.

item_id.description: Listing id, e.g. 'MLB1234567890'. Either this or dimensions.

dimensions.description: Package height x width x length in cm and weight in grams, e.g. '10x20x30,500'.

free_shipping.description: Whether the listing offers free shipping.

tools.name: mercado_libre_get_listing_prices
tools.description: Work out the selling fees for a price on a site: per listing type, the sale_fee_amount Mercado Libre keeps on each sale (with sale_fee_details: percentage, fixed fee, installments add-on), the listing_fee_amount and the currency. Add category_id and listing_type_id for an exact figure, e.g. to check a margin before setting a price.

listing_type_id.description: gold_special (classic) or gold_pro (premium). Leave out for all types.

logistic_type.description: drop_off, cross_docking or fulfillment, where the fee depends on it.

quantity.description: Quantity, for fees that depend on stock.

tools.name: mercado_libre_get_item_visits
tools.description: Get the total visits of one listing between two dates. Mercado Libre accepts one listing id per call: for several listings, call once per id. Returns total_visits and the date range. For a day-by-day series of one listing use mercado_libre_get_item_visits_by_day.

ids.description: One listing id, e.g. 'MLB1234567890'. Mercado Libre refuses more than one id here ("maximum amount of items to query is 1").

tools.name: mercado_libre_get_item_visits_by_day
tools.description: Get the daily visits of one listing over the last N days (time window up to 150 days). Returns total_visits and a results array with the visits per day, to spot a drop or a peak.

item_id.description: Listing id with site prefix, e.g. 'MLB1234567890'.

ending.description: Last day of the window, YYYY-MM-DD (default today).

tools.name: mercado_libre_get_product
tools.description: Get a catalog product by id: name, family, attributes, pictures, main features, the domain and buy_box_winner (the listing currently winning the product page, with its price and seller). Catalog product ids look like 'MLB12345678' and appear as catalog_product_id on a listing.

tools.name: mercado_libre_list_product_items
tools.description: List the listings that compete on a catalog product page: item_id, seller_id, price, currency, condition, listing type, shipping (free shipping, logistic type) and official store. Use it to compare your price with the other sellers of the same product; mercado_libre_get_item_price_to_win says what your listing needs to win.

tools.name: mercado_libre_get_item_price_to_win
tools.description: Check how a catalog listing competes for the product page: status (winning, sharing_first_place, competing, listed), price_to_win (the price that would make it win), the current winner and the boosts that count (free shipping, installments, Full). Only for catalog listings of the signed-in seller.

tools.name: mercado_libre_get_category_trends
tools.description: Get the most searched keywords of a category on a site, by recent growth and volume. Each entry has the keyword and a url to the search. Useful to pick words for titles and attributes.

tools.name: mercado_libre_search_questions
tools.description: Search buyers' questions on the seller's listings: by seller (all listings) or by one listing, optionally only UNANSWERED ones. Returns each question's id, text, status, date, item_id and the answer if there is one, plus total for paging. Answer with mercado_libre_post_answer.

seller_id.description: Seller id (numeric), the signed-in account. Either this or item.

item.description: Listing id, for the questions of one listing.

tools.name: mercado_libre_post_answer
tools.description: Publish the seller's answer to a buyer's question on a listing. The answer is public on the listing at once and cannot be edited afterwards. Write it in the site's language (Portuguese on MLB, Spanish elsewhere). Confirm the text with the user first.

text.description: Answer text, up to 2000 characters, no links or contact details.

tools.name: mercado_libre_list_seller_promotions
tools.description: List the promotions the seller is invited to or runs (seller-promotions API): id, type (DEAL, MARKETPLACE_CAMPAIGN, PRICE_DISCOUNT, LIGHTNING, DOD, VOLUME, SELLER_CAMPAIGN, SMART, PRICE_MATCHING, ...), status, start, finish and deadline dates, name and benefits (who funds the discount). Use the id and type with mercado_libre_list_promotion_items and mercado_libre_add_item_to_promotion.

tools.name: mercado_libre_get_promotion
tools.description: Get the details of one promotion: name, type, status, dates, deadline to join, benefits and, for seller campaigns, the discount rules. Needs the promotion type as well as the id (both from mercado_libre_list_seller_promotions).

promotion_type.description: Promotion type, e.g. DEAL, MARKETPLACE_CAMPAIGN, SELLER_CAMPAIGN, VOLUME, DOD, LIGHTNING, SMART, PRICE_MATCHING.

tools.name: mercado_libre_list_promotion_items
tools.description: List the seller's listings in a promotion with their status there (candidate = invited, pending, started, finished), price and original_price. Filter by status or one item_id. Pages of up to 50: pass paging.searchAfter from the answer as search_after for the next page (expires after 5 minutes); it is missing on the last page.

promotion_type.description: Promotion type, e.g. DEAL, MARKETPLACE_CAMPAIGN, SELLER_CAMPAIGN.

status.description: Only items in this promotion status.

status_item.description: Only listings in this listing status (default active).

tools.name: mercado_libre_get_item_promotions
tools.description: List every promotion a listing takes part in or is invited to: promotion id, type, status (candidate, pending, started), the price in the promotion and the original price, and for co-funded campaigns the meli and seller percentages.

item_id.description: Listing id with site prefix, e.g. 'MLB1234567890'.

tools.name: mercado_libre_add_item_to_promotion
tools.description: Add a listing to a promotion, or accept an invitation, at a promotional price. DEAL, SELLER_CAMPAIGN, DOD and LIGHTNING take a deal_price you set (LIGHTNING also stock); MARKETPLACE_CAMPAIGN, VOLUME, SMART and PRICE_MATCHING only need promotion_id and type (plus offer_id for SMART and PRICE_MATCHING), the price comes from the invitation. The discount is live for buyers once the promotion runs. Confirm price and promotion with the user first.

promotion_id.description: Promotion id. Not needed for PRICE_DISCOUNT.

promotion_type.description: Promotion type: DEAL, MARKETPLACE_CAMPAIGN, PRICE_DISCOUNT, LIGHTNING, DOD, VOLUME, PRE_NEGOTIATED, SELLER_CAMPAIGN, SMART, PRICE_MATCHING, UNHEALTHY_STOCK.

deal_price.description: Price during the promotion, for promotions where the seller sets it.

top_deal_price.description: Optional lower price for loyalty buyers (levels 3 to 6), where the promotion allows it.

offer_id.description: Candidate offer id, for SMART, PRICE_MATCHING and pre-negotiated promotions.

stock.description: Units reserved for a LIGHTNING deal.

tools.name: mercado_libre_remove_item_from_promotion
tools.description: Take a listing out of a promotion; it goes back to its normal price. Some promotions do not allow it once started (a running LIGHTNING deal can only be paused). Confirm with the user first.

promotion_type.description: Promotion type, e.g. DEAL, SELLER_CAMPAIGN, PRICE_DISCOUNT, DOD.

promotion_id.description: Promotion id, where the type has one.

offer_id.description: Offer id, for SMART and PRICE_MATCHING.

tools.name: mercado_libre_list_advertisers
tools.description: List the Mercado Ads advertiser accounts the signed-in user can reach for Product Ads: advertiser_id, site_id and name. Product Ads tools need both the advertiser_id and its site_id.

tools.name: mercado_libre_search_ad_campaigns
tools.description: List Product Ads campaigns of an advertiser with their status, budget, strategy and ACOS target and, with a date range and metrics, their results: clicks, prints, ctr, cost, cpc, acos, roas, units and amounts sold. metrics_summary adds totals; aggregation_type DAILY gives a series per day. Dates go back 90 days.

site_id.description: Advertiser's site id, e.g. 'MLB', from mercado_libre_list_advertisers.

aggregation_type.description: DAILY for one row per day.

offset.description: Results to skip; limit + offset at most 10000.

tools.name: mercado_libre_get_ad_campaign
tools.description: Get one Product Ads campaign: name, status, budget, strategy, ACOS or ROAS target and, with a date range and metrics, its results (clicks, prints, cost, acos, roas, sales, impression share and lost share by budget or rank).

aggregation_type.description: DAILY for one row per day.

tools.name: mercado_libre_search_product_ads
tools.description: List the Product Ads (one per promoted listing) of an advertiser with their status and campaign and, with a date range and metrics, each ad's results: clicks, prints, cost, cpc, acos, roas, units and amounts sold. Filter by campaign or by listing. metrics_summary adds totals; dates go back 90 days.

item_id.description: Only the ad of this listing.

aggregation_type.description: DAILY for one row per day.

offset.description: Results to skip; limit + offset at most 10000.

tools.name: mercado_libre_search_ad_groups
tools.description: Find the Product Ads ad groups of an advertiser, e.g. the ad group of given listings: returns each ad group's id, name, status, campaign_id and ad_group_external_id (the listing id). Use it to see which campaign promotes a listing.

campaign_id.description: Only ad groups of this campaign.
